rubric.criterion: Root AGENTS.md tells coding agents when to apply safe lint fixes, formatting, and the final strict lint check.
The final Oxlint command rejects warnings and uses the agent output format.
Commands use pnpm to execute the locally installed Oxlint and Oxfmt packages.
Safe lint fixes run before formatting.
The solution adds no hook framework, second linter, second formatter, or global package invocation.
